6b8557.title: AREA 3 — Upload/Download/IDOR results matrix
6b8557.content: Target http://172.17.112.1:8001 (DiscipLink PHP). Accounts: mhs 2341238901, dosen 1234567890, mhs2 2341238902, dosen2 1234567891, admin ADMIN001. HELD (negative results): - A1 Unrestricted upload: finfo MIME enforced server-side. .php/.phtml/.docx-blocked. PHP-as-.png/jpeg blocked. Polyglot only passes with valid image magic and lands with ORIGINAL extension (.jpg) -> non-executable. Content-Type client header ignored. - A2 Path traversal in filename: neutralized. Handler ignores client name, generates `__.`. Nothing written to /tmp or outside storage/uploads. Null byte in name also neutralized. - A3 Overwrite: random 12-byte suffix -> distinct files, delta=2 for 2 uploads. No overwrite. - A4 SVG/polyglot stored XSS: SVG MIME blocked; SVG-as-png blocked (finfo). News image upload allows only jpeg/png finfo. Served image/jpeg + nosniff. .php request in news dir -> 404. No exec, no inline HTML. - B5 Token sealing: tamper last char -> 403; cross-session replay (dosen->mhs, mhs2->mhs1, dosen2->dosen1) -> 403 (sid=sha256(session_id) binding + AEAD). Expiry enforced in app_token_decode (exp null). - B6 IDOR download: raw filename param -> 403 (must be a sealed token). Cross-user token replay -> 403. - B7 Direct path: /storage/uploads/ -> 403, /storage/keys/app_token.key -> 403, /config.php -> 403, /.env -> 403, traversal ..%2f -> 403. Only /storage/uploads/news/ (intended public) -> 200. - C8 Object IDOR: dosen2 replay dosen1 edit token -> 403; confirm_selesai token -> flash "Token detail pelanggaran tidak valid"; delete -> 302 but record NOT deleted (dosen1 still 6). mhs2 -> mhs1 upload id_detail -> invalid. Raw numeric id -> 403. - C9 dosen acting on non-owned: confirm/delete SQL scoped to id_dosen/id_dosen_penanggung_jawab; rejected via token sid anyway. - C10 mahasiswa->admin: POST /action/news, /action/tatib -> 403; /admin* -> 302. dosen->news -> 403. admin->dosen actions rejected (302). - Upload authz: SQL joins MAHASISWA/DOSEN by session nim/nidn; foreign/no/garbage id_detail -> "ID detail tidak valid". unauth -> Unauthorized. OBSERVATIONS (low / functional, not filed): - pelanggaran-page.php hardcodes download link to 'SURAT PERNYATAAN TI.pdf' => all mahasiswa download the SAME generic template PDF regardless of record. Functionality bug, low security relevance. - admin GET /pelanggaran/dosen -> 500 (admin lacks user_data.nidn). Robustness, no data leak (clean error page). - /storage/uploads/news/.jpg served publicly (by design for ). Files uploaded during test in storage/uploads (cleanup advisable): 8_suratPernyataan_b9986857..., etc, and news/bd6fa6fa...jpg.
